name: dropdown-with-keyboard-shortcuts
code:
"use client";

import {Button, Dropdown, Kbd, Label} from "@lenso/ui";

export function WithKeyboardShortcuts() {
  return (
    <Dropdown>
      <Button aria-label="菜单" variant="secondary">
        操作
      </Button>
      <Dropdown.Popover>
        <Dropdown.Menu onAction={(key) => console.log(`Selected: ${key}`)}>
          <Dropdown.Item id="new" textValue="新建">
            <Label>新建</Label>
            <Kbd className="ms-auto" slot="keyboard" variant="light">
              <Kbd.Abbr keyValue="command" />
              <Kbd.Content>N</Kbd.Content>
            </Kbd>
          </Dropdown.Item>
          <Dropdown.Item id="open" textValue="打开">
            <Label>打开</Label>
            <Kbd className="ms-auto" slot="keyboard" variant="light">
              <Kbd.Abbr keyValue="command" />
              <Kbd.Content>O</Kbd.Content>
            </Kbd>
          </Dropdown.Item>
          <Dropdown.Item id="save" textValue="保存">
            <Label>保存</Label>
            <Kbd className="ms-auto" slot="keyboard" variant="light">
              <Kbd.Abbr keyValue="command" />
              <Kbd.Content>S</Kbd.Content>
            </Kbd>
          </Dropdown.Item>
          <Dropdown.Item id="delete" textValue="删除" variant="danger">
            <Label>删除</Label>
            <Kbd className="ms-auto" slot="keyboard" variant="light">
              <Kbd.Abbr keyValue="command" />
              <Kbd.Abbr keyValue="shift" />
              <Kbd.Content>D</Kbd.Content>
            </Kbd>
          </Dropdown.Item>
        </Dropdown.Menu>
      </Dropdown.Popover>
    </Dropdown>
  );
}
